profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Endpoint Security & Windows Systems | C# · .NET · EDR
profile.summary: Software engineer with 20+ years in security software. Built core components of the CylanceOPTICS / Aurora Focus EDR platform at BlackBerry and Arctic Wolf: C# endpoint agent, Windows installer and packaging, ARM64 platform support, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-connected policy and telemetry. Led teams of 3 to 9 while staying deeply technical. Background covers endpoint detection and response, vulnerability management, and full-stack web development across cybersecurity-focused organizations.

positions.title: Staff Developer
positions.description:
• Led Windows ARM64 support for Aurora Focus 3.4 under a customer-committed deadline: performed compatibility analysis, rewrote build scripts from BAT to PowerShell, upgraded WiX to 3.14.1, replaced DifX with pnputil for driver installation, implemented a driver repackaging process for Microsoft signing, and updated updater code to support ARM64 infrastructure.
• Led rolling migration of 22 .NET 6 components to .NET 8 across the Aurora Focus agent, installer, and updater; updated 6 build servers to support .NET 8 and required C++ SDKs.
• Consolidated Windows installer and updater upload scripts from 8 to 3, eliminating configuration drift and reducing cross-script maintenance burden across staging and production pipelines.
• Contributed to the Aurora rebrand (CylanceOPTICS to Aurora Focus), updating UI and installer text across affected components.
• Improved Python-based test automation infrastructure, incrementally eliminating soft asserts to enforce clearer pass/fail outcomes and reduce QA analysis overhead.
• Monitored and maintained Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, resolving broken builds and updating Groovy and PowerShell scripts to ensure build stability.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Microsoft Copilot · NUnit · Artifactory · Python (Programming Language) · WiX Toolset · Team Leadership · Jenkins · Powershell

positions.title: Distinguished Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Managed a team of 5 software engineers on the CylanceOPTICS endpoint team: performance reviews, salary recommendations, code reviews, and day-to-day technical unblocking.
• Led Agile ceremonies for engineering and QA: daily standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
• Oversaw development and end-to-end testing of Remote Response for CylanceOPTICS, a console-based terminal interface allowing security teams to execute commands on remote endpoints in real time, validated across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
• Delivered the Intel TDT sensor configuration UI.
• Resolved a memory stability issue in the CylanceOPTICS Context Analysis Engine (CAE): implemented a 512MB queue cap that prevented unbounded memory growth and eliminated pipeline-backup out-of-memory conditions under sustained telemetry load.
• Diagnosed and fixed an unbounded CAE regex evaluation that could stall evaluation threads indefinitely; implemented a 5-second per-evaluation timeout to cap execution.
• Resolved CylanceOPTICS agent thread shutdown failures.
• Fixed an agent updater bug that could leave the endpoint agent in a broken state after an extraction timeout; extended the extraction timeout to reduce occurrence on lower-resource machines.
• Led end-to-end development of cloud-based policy configuration features (C#/ASP.NET), including a settings UI and policy microservice enabling new customer opt-in capabilities across hundreds of thousands of enterprise endpoints.
• Performed validation testing for the CylanceOPTICS 3.0 migration from local endpoint storage to a cloud data lake, verifying data integrity and testing InstaQuery, Focus View, and Advanced Query.
• Performed regression testing across CylanceOPTICS 3.1 and 3.2, including cloud data transmission changes, delivery optimizations, and soft and hard cap enforcement for cloud data volume.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET · C# · NUnit · REST APIs · Node.js · Project Management · Artifactory · JSON · React.js · Team Leadership · Jenkins · Powershell · Jira

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built high-traffic C# web services with Redis and SQL Server backends.
• Solely designed and implemented an internal support administration website (C#/SQL Server) for managing tenants, users, and product version assignment, still in active use post-acquisition.
• Led a team of 3 React developers for the forensics customer website including production deployments; contributed React/AWS CloudFront development.
• Managed 9 engineers and QA specialists across forensics development, sustaining, and build engineering.
• Designed and implemented MySQL databases for customer threat data; led migration to SQL Server as the customer base scaled. Analyzed and optimized heavily utilized SQL Server stored procedures to address performance issues at scale.
• Worked with DevOps to deploy and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure (Route 53, EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, S3), monitoring and troubleshooting production deployments under high-traffic conditions.
positions.insights: Skills: MySQL · C# · Software Development · NUnit · REST APIs · Project Management · Microsoft SQL Server · OAuth · React.js · Jira · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed C# middle-tier processor to consume XML from multiple vulnerability scanning agents and store results in SQL Server.
• Solely architected a data-intensive WinForms application for government agencies to report in the CyberScope standard format.
• Designed SQL architecture for SCAP results storage and retrieval.
• Implemented an ASP.NET update distribution server for deploying vulnerability manager updates inside corporate networks.
• Analyzed and optimized heavily utilized SQL stored procedures.
• Identified PHP processing bottlenecks resulting in significantly faster response times on high-load web servers.

positions.title: DBA / Software Engineer / Software Architect / Systems Administrator
positions.description: Developed REM, an enterprise C#/ASP.NET web application for aggregating and reporting vulnerability data from thousands of sources; administered SQL Server databases and rewrote stored procedures using advanced T-SQL techniques to significantly improve performance.

positions.title: DBA / Software Architect / Software Engineer / Systems Administrator
positions.description:
•	Responsible for setting up, securing, administering, maintaining, and updating Geneva, a business to business internet web application.   
•	Revamped and regularly upgraded the database architecture by employing key constraints, stored procedures, triggers and optimal indices.
•	Employed DTS to automate the importation of sales information into SQL Server.  Designed vendor-specific DTS packages that could be dropped in and modified independently.
•	Improved the application architecture and performance by employing reusable server-side objects and functions.
•	Used ADO, VBScript, XML, and XSLT on the server to produce web pages employing DHTML, HTML and JavaScript technologies.
•	Responsible for the administration and security of the application website, related FTP sites, and all company servers and LANs.
•	Managed co-located development and production servers using Remote Desktop Connection.
•	Administered Microsoft Visual SourceSafe for source control.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed well formulated test cases and used Open System Testing Architecture software to ascertain problem areas of website by scripting and simulating heavy user loads.  
•	Successfully prototyped and tested improvements to current system architecture which dramatically improved performance (approximately 40%), reliability, scalability, and security.
•	Reprogrammed web-based Helpdesk software by analyzing current architecture and formulating a design which modularized code and used solid SQL practices for data access.
•	Developed and demonstrated to coworkers how to improve performance and reliability of SQL 2000 database by utilizing key constraints, properly tuned indexes, stored procedures instead of embedded SQL, and the necessity of restricted data access.
•	Maintained company’s marketing e-commerce internet and intranet sites.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Analyzed and documented business processes of legacy software.
•	Worked regularly as a liaison between the Software Support and Information Services departments to identify problems and their solutions.
•	Interviewed candidate employees.
•	Programmed Real Estate transaction software for a large nationwide intranet, employing a three-tier architecture.
•	Designed and maintained web-based client GUI utilizing use cases and employing Visual Interdev 6.0.
•	Extensively used XML for data transport between Active-X components and Active Server Pages.
•	Utilized XSL for transforming XML into DHTML.
•	Scripted control of web pages via JavaScript and VBScript.
•	Developed and supported middle-tier interfaces to SQL databases using Visual Basic 6.0.
•	Generated and debugged SQL stored procedures.
•	Maintained legacy software using Visual Basic and Crystal Reports.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Programmed Financial Applications for major banks using Visual Basic 5.0.
•	Developed and maintained interfaces to SQL and Sybase databases.
•	Maintained and updated company web page.

positions.title: Information Technician
positions.description:
•	Installed and supported ZenWorks 1.1 on Novell servers for multiple sites.
•	Installed Solaris 2.5.1 and configured network support for Sun Ultra 5 servers.
•	Supported users on a Novell 4.11 network.
•	Researched Y2k and upgraded PCs and software in accordance.
•	Created and maintained company intranet homepage.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science with a minor in Social Sciences
